brief.headline: Freeze their price at ₹250/kg (the fair-market line) and shift to 15-day payment to free up ₹320 cash for us

priceAsk.summary: Hold their price at ₹250/kg and lock it for 12 months
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows typical pharma ORS sachet laminate asks are ₹250/kg; their current pricing sits at the top of the fair band (₹205–305/kg). With the raw BOPET film import benchmark at 171.60 ₹/kg, there's room in their margin to hold this line.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt

brief.financialLeverage: Silk Polypack publishes no financials, so we can't judge their cash position or health from reports. Our annual spend with them is ₹7775 — small for us, but we don't know how big that is for them. Without their numbers, we build our plan on three things: the open-market price (which shows their ask is fair but at the top), the fact that we already have proven backup converters lined up, and the faster payment we can offer. Push confidently on price and terms, but stay professional — we need the supply stable while we qualify a second source.

evidence.point: Market asking price for pharma ORS sachet laminate sits at ₹250/kg typically
Their pricing is at the top of the fair market band
Raw BOPET film import cost benchmark is much lower
Moving to 15-day payment frees up cash for us
We have proven listed converters as backup — Huhtamaki and UFLEX both do pharma laminate sachets at scale

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volume — proven and can scale up laminate sachets

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant that makes both the film substrate and does conversion — can second-source laminates at large scale

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global group's India converter doing pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source option (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health score D 31/100, so verify stability first)

risks: Silk Polypack's financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their stability — watch for any supply hiccups and accelerate second-source trials
Our ₹7775 annual spend is tiny; if we're not material to them they may walk rather than cut price — be ready with the faster-payment sweetener
Market backups like Polyplex, Garware, SRF, Ester and Jindal are film makers (substrate), not converters — they benchmark raw material cost but won't replace a laminate converter directly
Constantia Parikh's health score is D (31/100) — if you RFQ them, audit their supply continuity before committing volume
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to lock ₹250/kg for the next twelve months and move to 15-day payment — that's the fair market line and faster cash for you.
